title: Tigers vs leopards in India

scenes.headline: For every wild tiger in India, how many leopards?
And that leopard count is an undercount.
scenes.body: It covered about 70% of leopard habitat. Himalayan and semi-arid areas weren't sampled.

scenes.headline: Tigers are climbing too.
scenes.body: From 2,967 in 2018 to 3,682 in 2022, about 6% a year.

caption:
India has roughly four leopards for every tiger.

Madhya Pradesh leads both counts, with an estimated 785 tigers and 3,907 leopards in 2022.

Sources: NTCA & WII, Status of Tigers, Co-predators and Prey in India 2022; Status of Leopards in India 2022. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Head-to-head with real Indian census data, plus the caveat that makes the comparison honest (leopard count is partial).
